coverage_limits: Bounded live search on October 26, 2026. No qualifying same-day submission or revision was verified in the browsed source set; two newly discovered earlier papers are retained separately.
arXiv new/recent pages for cs.GR, cs.CV, cs.HC and cs.AI were inspected selectively. Three CV pages were opened, not every abstract was read. cs.RO, cs.MM and eess.IV were not separately enumerated.
Hugging Face target-date page failed twice. OpenReview and official venues were searched through the web index only. These checks cannot establish complete coverage.
Same-day submission timestamps differ from public listing dates. Both retained papers have primary-source submission dates before October 26.
The live source document revision differs from the pinned October 11 research codebook; classifications deliberately use the pinned 18 fields and are not silently aligned to the newer manuscript.
The installed skill workflow and its offline prepare/finalize scripts ran with live browser retrieval. This is not a separate API harness benchmark run.
Two candidates received selected primary-method reading, one was excluded from its abstract. General graphics-model and product-release leads were not treated as agent papers.
Publication indexes may lag. Unread leads remain in pending-queue.json; no field-wide completeness is claimed.

papers.canonical_title: SceneBloom: Agentic Indoor Environment Generation with Realistic and Diverse Layouts for Embodied Learning
papers.abstract: Combines VLM zone planning, diffusion-based furniture layouts, and geometric compilation to create simulation-ready indoor scenes.
papers.screening_reason: Relevant scene authoring; the inspected repair stage uses fixed geometric operators rather than an established feedback-driven model revision loop.

screening_evidence.evidence: A VLM plans zones and extracts relations. Geometry fitting and relation-specific local corrections produce the scene.

papers.contribution: Combines VLM zone planning, diffusion-based furniture layouts, and geometric compilation to create simulation-ready indoor scenes.
papers.limitations: Scope needs review. Simulation-ready geometry alone is not dynamic authoring.

papers.abstract: Tests coding agents on 112 XR development tasks, including application creation and repairs, with simulated interactions and visual or programmatic checks.
papers.screening_reason: An evaluation benchmark for interactive XR authoring, not one graphics-generation method.

papers.canonical_title: StackGen3D: Stable 3D Block Stack Generation from Multiview Silhouettes
papers.abstract: Generates stable block arrangements with a learned stability predictor and conditional flow matching.
papers.screening_reason: The abstract describes a generative model with geometric refinement, not a language-model agent directing graphics actions.

screening_evidence.evidence: PI-GNN curates stable examples, and flow matching generates block configurations.

papers.contribution: Generates stable block arrangements with a learned stability predictor and conditional flow matching.
